description: Codex's own MCP server (notion, from its config file) is switched off for the thread, Codex having no strict MCP mode. Start in Ask first (untrusted approval, workspace-write sandbox) with the worktree as cwd: the first prompt opens the handshake, the thread starts and the queued prompt becomes turn 1; agent text, a shell call, token usage (cached input subtracted), a finished turn, then a second prompt as turn 2. Synthesised from the codex app-server JSON schema generated by codex-cli 0.144.1 (`codex app-server generate-json-schema`), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture (see crates/codex-adapter/README.md).
